story.title: Texas Supreme Court mulls candidate’s eligibility in House 93 race
story.summary: Former Fort Worth City Council member Alan Blaylock is contesting election winner Ericka Lomick’s eligibility to serve. The Texas Supreme Court is weighing whether it has jurisdiction to intervene in the unusual dispute over whether Ericka Lomick, who won the race for the state’s House 93 seat in north Fort Worth, is ineligible because she’s a convicted felon. Former Fort Worth City Council member Alan Blaylock, who lost special and general election races to Lomick on Nov. 3; Lomick; and Texas Secretary of State Robert Howden filed responses with the Texas Supreme Court by the court’s Monday deadline. Blaylock petitioned the court Nov. 16 to order Howden to review the Lomick case record and, “upon determining that it establishes ineligibility,” declare Lomick ineligible as a candidate in the special election, a ruling which would lead to another special election to fill the empty seat…
